source.label: CLN3 disease
source.summary: The most common form of Batten disease. It usually starts at school age with vision loss, followed by seizures and loss of skills.

target.label: Lysosomal degradation (ceroid lipofuscin storage)
target.summary: Cells break down worn-out parts inside lysosomes. In all NCLs this recycling fails and waste (lipofuscin) builds up, especially in nerve cells.

supporting.quote: [MOCK] Loss of CLN3 disrupts lysosomal function and leads to storage material accumulation.
